model.transition: static structural zero diagonal, positive off-diagonal

initialization.emissions: shared training-only Lloyd20 quantiles0.125/0.375/0.625/0.875, observed population variance, sorted initial means; same existing initializer
initialization.known_reference: true static transition and initial laws held fixed; separate information reference

fit.all_arms: learn Gaussian emissions and fixed-bin durations
fit.estimated_joint: also learn static transition and initial laws from soft posterior boundary/start counts

evaluation.primary: estimated joint versus estimated frozen; same observations and complete initial model
evaluation.baseline: each arm's complete initial model; gain includes Gaussian/duration/chain learning as applicable
evaluation.alignment: post-fit mean-sort permutation for metrics only; permute both axes of transition and initial vector consistently; do not relabel fitted model during learning
evaluation.outer_and_truth: only after all three complete fits; no labels or true-law duration support in learning or selection

integrity: freeze complete dependency/software/protocol manifest and source commit before fresh fits
exact resume with all parameter groups and update counters
independent terminal and outer LL, public gradients for all five groups and causal/segment filtering
limitations: scalar Gaussian, fixed-bin durations and static chain; no neural/Trading/legacy NPZ acceptance
known reference changes information and initialization
frozen estimated-chain failure can reflect a transition gate failure without failed duration recovery; report each gate separately
bounded EM is not a global convergence guarantee
